description.value: L'OTUS Cake Boutique is an artisan cake shop specializing in handcrafted crepe cakes, chiffon layer cakes, cheesecakes, and gelato with Asian-inspired flavour profiles such as matcha yuzu and mango sticky rice. It operates on a pre-order pickup model, so cyclists planning a stop should order in advance. The boutique offers a distinctive selection of visually elaborate celebration cakes that would make an unusual but memorable mid-tour treat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and shows a functioning Square online store for cake pre-orders with pickup at '8580 Cambie Rd. #103', which conflicts directly with the OSM address of '4352 Beresford Street, Burnaby'; per rules, the website address is used and the discrepancy flagged. The site confirms the business is open (2026 specials listed, live cart), operating as a pickup-only cake boutique with no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist amenities. Takeout/pickup is the core business model per the ordering interface.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists '4352 Beresford Street, Burnaby' but website shows pickup location as '8580 Cambie Rd. #103' — OSM address appears incorrect or outdated. The Cambie Rd address is near the Richmond/Vancouver border, not central Burnaby.
OSM tags this as amenity=restaurant but it is a pickup-only cake boutique with no dine-in indicated on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a live ordering site and 2026 products listed; useful to touring cyclists as a food stop.

wow_evidence: pre-order pickup model, so cyclists planning a stop should order in advance

price.label: Cheap eats
price.signal: pre-order cake boutique; per-person dessert spend under $15
